name: pairs
description: Derived code-graph index for AI coding agents
author: Mustafa Kiyar

pairs.disabledTools.description: Tool names to not register as in-editor Language Model Tools, e.g. "analyze".

languageModelTools.name: pairs_find_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find where a symbol is defined by name (bare or qualified), workspace-wide. Returns definitions with file:line, kind, and signature. Use INSTEAD of grep/Read to locate a definition. Ambiguous names return the candidate list so you can re-call qualified. Pass preview:true to also get each hit's doc and first body lines, which usually removes the follow-up Read.

name.description: Bare or qualified name, e.g. "login" or "AuthService::login".

offset.description: Skip this many results — re-call with the offset from a truncated response to page.

preview.description: Include the symbol's doc line and first few body lines with each hit — usually removes the follow-up Read.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_get_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Full declaration of a symbol by name: signature, doc, span, and (for a type/impl) its members. Use INSTEAD of Read when you need a symbol's shape, not its body.

path.description: Disambiguation hint: prefer the symbol defined in this file (workspace-relative path or suffix).

includeMembers.description: List members of a type/impl (methods, fields).

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_outline
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Structural outline of a file: its symbols, signatures, and line ranges, ordered by position. Use INSTEAD of Read when you need a file's shape.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_impact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: What transitively DEPENDS ON a symbol ("blast radius"): every caller, reader, and implementer that reaches it, up to `depth` hops. Call BEFORE renaming/removing/changing a symbol, or on "what depends on X". Catches renamed-import references grep misses. Fuzzy (name-matched) dependants are marked as such. Set includeTests:false to walk only production dependants (test-only paths are excluded from the walk, not just hidden). Pass kinds to slice by edge type (e.g. kinds:["CALLS"] for callers only).

name.description: Bare or qualified name of the symbol to analyze.

path.description: Disambiguation hint: prefer the symbol defined in this file (workspace-relative path or suffix).

includeTests.description: Include dependants reached only through test files. Off filters test-only paths out of the walk entirely, not just the rendered list.

kinds.description: Restrict the walk to these dependency edge kinds — e.g. ["CALLS"] for callers only, ["READS","WRITES"] for data access. Omit for all kinds.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_diff_impact
languageModelTools.displayName: PAiRS: impact of the current diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Blast radius of the CURRENT CHANGE: maps the git diff's changed line ranges to the symbols containing them, then walks every dependant of all of them in one merged pass. Use INSTEAD of reading the diff and then calling `impact` once per changed function — dependants reached from several changed symbols appear once, tagged with which ones reach them. Answers "what do I need to re-test / re-review for this change". Changed lines that sit in no symbol (imports, module-level code, unindexed files) are reported separately, never silently dropped. Defaults to the unstaged working tree; pass `rev` for a revision or range like "main...HEAD".

rev.description: Git revision or range to diff, e.g. "HEAD" or "main...HEAD". Omit for uncommitted working-tree changes.

staged.description: Diff the index (`git diff --staged`) instead of the working tree. Ignored when `rev` is set.

depth.description: Transitive hops to walk from each changed symbol.

offset.description: Skip this many results — re-call with the offset from a truncated response to page.

includeTests.description: Include dependants reached only through test files.

kinds.description: Restrict the walk to these dependency edge kinds. Omit for all kinds.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_hierarchy
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inheritance/interface tree around a type: what it EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS (ancestors) and what EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS it (descendants), up to `depth` hops each way. Call on "what does X inherit from", "what implements X", or before changing a base class/interface to see every subclass affected. Narrower than `impact` (which also includes CALLS/READS/WRITES); use this when you specifically want the type hierarchy, not the full dependant set.

name.description: Bare or qualified name of the class/interface/trait to analyze.

path.description: Disambiguation hint: prefer the symbol defined in this file (workspace-relative path or suffix).

depth.description: Transitive hops to walk, each direction.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_who_calls
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Direct call sites of a function/method ("callers"), or what it calls ("callees"). Lighter than `impact` when you only want one hop. Catches renamed imports grep misses. Set includeTests:false to hide test-file callers/callees — the footer reports how many were hidden.

path.description: Disambiguation hint: prefer the symbol defined in this file (workspace-relative path or suffix).

includeTests.description: Include edges whose reference site is in a test file. Off hides them and the footer states how many were hidden.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_file_deps
languageModelTools.modelDescription: File-level dependency graph: which files depend on this one ("importers", the blast radius) or what it depends on ("imports"). Call BEFORE moving/deleting a file or on "what would break".

transitive.description: Walk up to 5 hops; results carry their depth.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_module_map
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The module (directory) dependency graph: detected subsystems (Louvain clusters), module CYCLES, each module's dependency LAYER and fan-in/fan-out, the most depended-on modules, and explicit-vs-implicit DRIFT (how much dependency weight crosses cluster boundaries). Call on "what are the subsystems", "where does this belong", "what is safe to change", "is the architecture drifting", or before a big refactor. High drift means the folder layout and the real dependencies disagree; cycles mean no layering holds at all.

depth.description: Collapse modules to this many leading path segments — use on large monorepos to keep the map legible.

resolution.description: Louvain resolution: >1 finds more/smaller subsystems, <1 fewer/larger ones.

boundary.description: Drill into one edge instead of the whole map: "<from module> -> <to module>" (module keys as printed by a plain module_map call). Returns the symbols of the target module that the source actually uses, with reference sites — i.e. exactly what breaking that dependency would require.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_analyze
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Workspace-wide architectural analyses. `kind`: dead_code (zero-reference symbols — candidates, not verdicts), fan_out (functions with the most outgoing calls), cycles (dependency cycles at module or type scope), test_gap (exported symbols with no test referencing them).

pathPrefix.description: Limit to files under this workspace-relative directory.

excludePath.description: Skip files under this directory (e.g. tests).

offset.description: Skip this many results — re-call with the offset from a truncated response to page.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_rename_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename a symbol and every direct reference site (definition + callers/readers/writers/implementers found via the same edges `impact` walks) consistently, in one pass. Aborts without touching any file if a reference site cannot be matched safely (e.g. the indexed line no longer contains the name at a word boundary) — re-index and retry. Aborts without writing if any reference site is fuzzy (name-only match) unless includeFuzzy is set. Revert via your VCS (e.g. `git checkout -- <files>`); this tool does not keep its own undo log.

name.description: Bare or qualified name of the symbol to rename.

path.description: Disambiguation hint: prefer the symbol defined in this file (workspace-relative path or suffix).

includeFuzzy.description: Also rename reference sites reached by fuzzy (name-only) edges. Off by default: those sites may belong to an unrelated symbol sharing the name.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_grep_symbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search symbol names, qualified names, signatures, and doc text by substring or regex, returning graph citations (not file contents). Use when you know roughly what you're looking for but not the exact symbol name — a plain-text search over the index instead of grep-and-Read over the filesystem.

pattern.description: Substring (default) or regex to match against name/qualified/signature/doc.

isRegex.description: Treat `pattern` as a regular expression instead of a plain substring.

pathPrefix.description: Limit to files under this workspace-relative directory.

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pairs_context_pack
languageModelTools.modelDescription: One assembled bundle for a symbol or file: its definition, direct callers, direct callees, type hierarchy (if a type), and enclosing module boundary. Composes find_symbol/who_calls/hierarchy/module_map into a single call — use this instead of making all of those calls separately when you need broad context on one symbol or file fast.

name.description: Symbol name (bare or qualified). Provide this or `path`.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, for a file-level pack. Provide this or `name`.

limit.description: Max items per section (callers, callees, etc).

workspaceFolder.description: Name of the workspace folder to target when multiple are open. Omit to use the first/only workspace folder.
